question: Using the explicitly requested experimental SOFA-2-based Sepsis-3 phenotype (sep3_sofa2), estimate its prevalence among adult ICU stays and report observed in-hospital mortality (death) counts and proportions for stays with and without the phenotype, with exact denominators and a transparent reproducible cohort definition. This development analysis is descriptive only. Because patient identity is unavailable, report observed counts and proportions only: do not compute p-values, hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, risk differences, patient-clustered intervals, causal effects, or independence-sensitive inference.
